changes.name: StarterEggSystem
changes.source:
local egg=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap"):WaitForChild("StarterEgg"):WaitForChild("Egg")
local prompt=egg:WaitForChild("HatchPrompt")
local pets={{"Cloud Bunny",60},{"Sky Fox",30},{"Sun Cub",9},{"Storm Dragon",1}}
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats");local coins=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
 if not coins or coins.Value<10 then return end
 coins.Value-=10
 local r=math.random(1,100);local total=0;local pet=pets[1][1]
 for _,v in ipairs(pets) do total+=v[2];if r<=total then pet=v[1];break end end
 local inv=player:FindFirstChild("Pets")
 if not inv then inv=Instance.new("Folder");inv.Name="Pets";inv.Parent=player end
 local owned=Instance.new("StringValue");owned.Name=pet;owned.Value=pet;owned.Parent=inv
 prompt.ObjectText="HATCHED: "..pet
 task.delay(2,function() if prompt.Parent then prompt.ObjectText="STARTER EGG" end end)
end)
